notes.title: Egg Squeeze v1.2.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2.2 Patch Notes

 Made dialogue that has already been seen skippable
 Fixed a bug where buddy's mouth would move before speaking
 Set the title screen's credits link to view the credits roll after the game has been beaten
 Fixed a bug where the flower would not save a pink egg from cracking
 Miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: Egg Squeeze v1.2.1
notes.content:
Version 1.2.1 Patch Notes


 Fixed various stability issues
 Fixed a bug where restarting after a game over would result in the same random seed being used
 Fixed a bug on the title screen that allowed you to select locked game modes
 Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: Egg Squeeze Original Soundtrack
notes.content:
You asked, and we answered.

The Egg Squeeze original soundtrack is now available for purchase via Bandcamp! Support us by buying the OST, and listen to your favorite tracks in squeeze-less bliss without breaking an egg.


47 Original game tracks
Tracks by FLOOR BABA, Adam Carey, and pngsequence
A truly eggciting soundscape for the ages
